annotations.title: Show or hide the Fillo badge

description: Show or hide the Fillo badge on every form this workspace renders. Hiding it requires the paid plan; without it the call is refused rather than silently ignored. Visible to every respondent, but reversible in one call, so it is a routine change. Needs a LOGIN TOKEN.

show.description: true shows the Fillo badge, false hides it.
